Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2.2: Love for parents

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: LOVE FOR PARENTS

This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Love for parents helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: LOVE FOR PARENTS

PART 1: Demonstrate ways parents/guardians do for them. 3.

What this means
In this part you learn to Demonstrate ways parents/guardians do for them. 3.. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Demonstrate ways parents/guardians do for them. 3..
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Love for parents” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: Demonstrate ways parents/guardians do for them. 3.)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Love for parents in your own words. (skill: Appreciate the role of children exchanging gifts parents in their day to  Learners recite dua for their day life. parents)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Love for parents to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Demonstrate ways parents/guardians do for them. 3..
3. Practise this skill: Appreciate the role of children exchanging gifts parents in their day to  Learners recite dua for their day life. parents.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Love for parents from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Love for parents: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Love for parents?
